scripts.lint:service: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff check service && node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format --check service
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:service && cargo clippy --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:service && npm run test:ui
scripts.bindings: node scripts/python.mjs -m tawreed.openapi ui/src/api/openapi.json && openapi-typescript ui/src/api/openapi.json -o ui/src/api/schema.ts
scripts.package:service: node scripts/python.mjs -m PyInstaller service/packaging/tawreed-service.spec --distpath service/dist --workpath service/build --noconfirm --log-level WARN
scripts.package: npm run package:service && tauri build --config desktop/tauri.release.conf.json
